name: Bee Scout
description: Point at a plant or pollinator. Hear a cautious ID and a bee-friendly action from Beeswax.

permissions.description: Takes one photo when you press the glasses button, so Beeswax can judge the prop you're looking at. Photos are never saved.
Hears your questions for Beeswax ("what if a fire starts?") and what you say about a prop you scan.

hardwareRequirements.description: A second mic for the what-if questions.
Short press scans, long press replays the last line.
Amber while scanning, green or red for the verdict.
